as.finding.murmur: Crescendo-decrescendo systolic ejection murmur at the right upper sternal border, radiating to the carotids; softer S2, a late-peaking murmur in severe disease.
as.finding.headline: Aortic stenosis: aortic 109/68 mmHg, saturation 98%

ar.finding.murmur: Early diastolic decrescendo murmur at the left sternal border, bounding pulses and a wide pulse pressure.
ar.finding.headline: Aortic regurgitation: aortic 108/32 mmHg, saturation 98%

ms.finding.murmur: Opening snap then low-pitched mid-diastolic rumble at the apex, with presystolic accentuation in sinus rhythm.
ms.finding.headline: Mitral stenosis: aortic 87/52 mmHg, saturation 98%

mr.finding.murmur: Holosystolic murmur at the apex radiating to the axilla.
mr.finding.headline: Mitral regurgitation: aortic 98/52 mmHg, saturation 98%

ts.finding.murmur: Diastolic rumble at the left lower sternal border, louder with inspiration.
ts.finding.headline: Tricuspid stenosis: aortic 98/59 mmHg, saturation 98%

tr.finding.murmur: Holosystolic murmur at the left lower sternal border, louder with inspiration, with a prominent jugular v wave.
tr.finding.headline: Tricuspid regurgitation: aortic 90/54 mmHg, saturation 98%

ps.finding.murmur: Systolic ejection murmur at the left upper sternal border with an ejection click; a soft P2.
ps.finding.headline: Pulmonary stenosis: aortic 102/61 mmHg, saturation 98%

pr.finding.murmur: Early diastolic decrescendo murmur at the left upper sternal border (Graham Steell if pulmonary hypertension).
pr.finding.headline: Pulmonary regurgitation: aortic 102/61 mmHg, saturation 98%

pda.finding.murmur: Systolic murmur at the left infraclavicular area while pulmonary resistance is high, becoming the continuous 'machinery' murmur as it falls; bounding pulses.
pda.finding.headline: Patent ductus arteriosus: aortic 59/19 mmHg, saturation 98%, Qp:Qs 2.36

asd.finding.murmur: Soft systolic flow murmur at the left upper sternal border and a fixed split S2.
asd.finding.headline: Atrial septal defect: aortic 94/56 mmHg, saturation 97%, Qp:Qs 1.47

vsd.finding.murmur: Harsh holosystolic murmur at the left lower sternal border; louder when small and restrictive, quiet when large and pressure-equalizing.
vsd.finding.headline: Ventricular septal defect: aortic 49/26 mmHg, saturation 98%, Qp:Qs 2.56

tof.finding.murmur: Harsh systolic ejection murmur at the left upper sternal border from the outflow obstruction (it shortens as a spell deepens), single loud S2, and cyanosis.
tof.finding.headline: Tetralogy of Fallot: aortic 58/32 mmHg, saturation 87%

pa-vsd.finding.murmur: Single S2, no outflow murmur; a continuous murmur from the duct or collaterals; cyanosis that deepens as the duct closes.
pa-vsd.finding.headline: Pulmonary atresia with VSD: aortic 58/22 mmHg, saturation 82%, Qp:Qs 1.22

pa-ivs.finding.murmur: Single S2, a tricuspid regurgitation murmur at the left lower sternal border, a continuous murmur from the duct; cyanosis that deepens as the duct closes.
pa-ivs.finding.headline: Pulmonary atresia, intact septum: aortic 47/17 mmHg, saturation 72%, Qp:Qs 1.17

tri-atresia.finding.murmur: Single S2; a systolic murmur from the VSD if present; cyanosis; left-axis deviation on the ECG.
tri-atresia.finding.headline: Tricuspid atresia: aortic 50/26 mmHg, saturation 76%

ebstein.finding.murmur: Soft systolic murmur of tricuspid regurgitation, multiple clicks, a widely split S1 and S2; cyanosis in the newborn that improves as the pulmonary resistance falls.
ebstein.finding.headline: Ebstein anomaly: aortic 46/18 mmHg, saturation 73%, Qp:Qs 1.10
